## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.4c93d27b"></a>**1. index.ts is a barrel module that re-exports the Button, Alert, Loading, Card, and Modal components together with their prop types (ButtonProps, AlertProps, LoadingProps, CardProps, ModalProps).**
  [`index.ts:1-15`](../index.ts#L1-L15)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.71789013"></a>**2. All five components in this unit (Alert, Button, Card, Loading, Modal) are client components, each file beginning with the 'use client' directive.**
  [`Alert.tsx:1-1`](../Alert.tsx#L1-L1)
  [`Button.tsx:1-1`](../Button.tsx#L1-L1)
  [`Card.tsx:1-1`](../Card.tsx#L1-L1)
  [`Loading.tsx:1-1`](../Loading.tsx#L1-L1)
  [`Modal.tsx:1-1`](../Modal.tsx#L1-L1)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.8fc44071"></a>**3. ButtonProps extends React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> and adds variant ('primary' | 'secondary' | 'ghost' | 'outline'), size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg'), loading (boolean), and children (React.ReactNode).**
  [`Button.tsx:5-10`](../Button.tsx#L5-L10)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.a2a4d929"></a>**4. Modal renders a native <dialog> element with the class 'modal'; a useEffect calls showModal() when isOpen becomes true and close() when it becomes false, and onClose is invoked both from the dialog's onClose event and when a click on the dialog element itself (the backdrop) is detected.**
  [`Modal.tsx:12-38`](../Modal.tsx#L12-L38)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.1da5943e"></a>**5. typeClasses maps each Alert type to a DaisyUI alert class: info to alert-info, success to alert-success, warning to alert-warning, and error to alert-error.**
  [`Alert.tsx:11-16`](../Alert.tsx#L11-L16)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.d0e43f76"></a>**6. Alert renders a dismissible status message: a div with role="alert" whose className combines the base 'alert' class with a type-specific class from typeClasses, containing the message text and, when onDismiss is provided, a ghost button with an X icon that invokes onDismiss.**
  [`Alert.tsx:18-47`](../Alert.tsx#L18-L47)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.80dbf7cf"></a>**7. Button renders a native button element whose className is built from the base 'btn' class, the variant class, the size class, and any caller-supplied className joined with spaces; the button is disabled when either disabled or loading is true, and a spinner span is rendered before the children when loading is true.**
  [`Button.tsx:25-51`](../Button.tsx#L25-L51)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.206ce3a0"></a>**8. variantClasses maps each Button variant to a DaisyUI class (primary to btn-primary, secondary to btn-secondary, ghost to btn-ghost, outline to btn-outline) and sizeClasses maps each size (sm to btn-sm, md to btn-md, lg to btn-lg); Button defaults variant to 'primary', size to 'md', and loading to false.**
  [`Button.tsx:12-23`](../Button.tsx#L12-L23)
  [`Button.tsx:25-33`](../Button.tsx#L25-L33)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.513b77f1"></a>**9. Card renders a div with the classes 'card' and 'bg-base-100', adding 'card-border' when bordered is true and any caller-supplied className, and wraps its children in a 'card-body' div.**
  [`Card.tsx:11-26`](../Card.tsx#L11-L26)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.f9bbb9f7"></a>**10. Loading renders a flex container with a spinner span carrying the 'loading loading-spinner' classes plus a size class (defaulting to 'md'), and an optional text span rendered when text is provided.**
  [`Loading.tsx:16-23`](../Loading.tsx#L16-L23)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.67d14761"></a>**11. Modal renders a 'modal-box' div containing an optional title heading, a circular ghost close button labelled 'Close modal' that invokes onClose, and the children, followed by a 'modal-backdrop' form whose close button also invokes onClose.**
  [`Modal.tsx:40-55`](../Modal.tsx#L40-L55)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.50ccbeea"></a>**12. AlertProps declares type as one of 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'error', message as a required string, and onDismiss as an optional callback with no arguments.**
  [`Alert.tsx:5-9`](../Alert.tsx#L5-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.8146bcfd"></a>**13. CardProps declares children as a required React.ReactNode, bordered as an optional boolean that defaults to false, and className as an optional string that defaults to an empty string.**
  [`Card.tsx:5-9`](../Card.tsx#L5-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.836f7ded"></a>**14. LoadingProps declares size as an optional 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' that defaults to 'md' and text as an optional string; sizeClasses maps each size to loading-sm, loading-md, and loading-lg respectively.**
  [`Loading.tsx:5-14`](../Loading.tsx#L5-L14)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-common.3a868828"></a>**15. ModalProps declares isOpen (boolean), onClose (callback with no arguments), an optional title (string), and children (React.ReactNode).**
  [`Modal.tsx:5-10`](../Modal.tsx#L5-L10)
